payload.title: Getting data into LiPD
payload.description: This workflow demonstrates the process of using PyLiPD to convert CSV-based chronology data into the LiPD data format. It involves generating unique identifiers, loading empty LiPD files, and exporting them to a Datasets object.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries and classes for handling data conversion and manipulation.
steps.title: Import Libraries

steps.description: Define a function to generate a random UUID and convert it to the required format.
steps.title: Generate Unique Identifier

steps.description: Retrieve the list of empty LiPD files to be used for data conversion.
steps.title: Load Empty LiPD Files

steps.description: Convert CSV-based chronology data into the LiPD format and export it to a Datasets object.
steps.title: Data Conversion and Export
